summary: The label implications, positivity of the truncated convex bodies, both Brunn-Minkowski lower bounds, the B-automaton implication, and all branch contradictions are valid. Independent enumeration gives 220 allowed forbidden P,Q pairs, 12 N/P-only pairs, 7,248 mixed vectors, no fixed vectors, 3,624 reduced deletions in each of the two branches, and 49,026 final survivors.
